reflections.summary: Lost because the 4 brought were blanked by opponent immunities - Garchomp Earthquake does 0 to Levitate Mega Delphox (noted immune turn 6) and Dragonite Dragon Claw does 0 to Whimsicott, leaving no answer to Delphox Psychic spam. Arcanine + Dragonite collapsed turn 5 to Psychic + Triple Axel (Dragonite to 4%), then forced Garchomp Protect stall vs Psychic/Moonblast which was punished by Whimsicott Encore turn 10 into KO turn 12.
reflections.adjustment: Do not bring Garchomp + Dragonite together vs Delphox-Mega + Whimsicott core. Drop EQ-reliant Ground and Dragon-spam; bring Dark/Ghost coverage for Delphox and spread/priority (Rock Slide, Fake Out, Extreme Speed) to break Whimsicott Sash early and avoid Protect-Encore lock. Preserve Intimidate is useless vs special Delphox - need special bulk or offensive pressure instead.

reflections.summary: The win came from a well-matched preview plan: Mega Delphox’s Speed and Levitate provided safe pressure beside Tsareena, Tsareena nearly removed Dragonite, and Whimsicott’s Encore converted Garchomp’s repeated Protects into free attacks. The chosen four and Mega Delphox were appropriate; Basculegion was not needed.
reflections.adjustment: Keep the same four and evolve Delphox again; prioritize denying Dragonite’s Tailwind, then preserve Whimsicott to Encore Garchomp after Protect rather than exposing Basculegion early.
reflections.notebook: Rotom-Mow can stall physical attackers with Sitrus Berry, Will-O-Wisp, and Protect, so weaken it before committing Basculegion. Dragonite is Lum Berry Multiscale with Tailwind and may seek speed control. Sneasler is Focus Sash Unburden. Garchomp is Jolly Life Orb Rough Skin and repeatedly attempts consecutive Protects; punish this with Prankster Encore. Arcanine is defensive Intimidate with Leftovers and Will-O-Wisp. Mega Delphox’s Levitate and Speed make it the preferred Mega here, especially beside Tsareena or into Garchomp. Tsareena protects allies from priority and threatens Dragonite with reliable Wide Lens Triple Axel. Whimsicott outspeeds Garchomp naturally and threatens it with Moonblast.
